lineage: game-compiler - Sony/Cygnus 2.9-ee-991111b (patched game default; SN parity target)
provenance: SN-distributed GNUPro/SCE source; Wayback ps2dev.sourceforge.net ee/gnu-ee-binutils-gcc-1.1.tar.gz (sha256 1f518043e252d6eda726386971d52eda26541ab936ea73a9783d73712b595f92)
role: Opt-in (-mastra-annul-dead-slots): after delay-slot scheduling, mark a conditional branch as annulled (branch-likely) when its delay-slot instruction writes the register the branch tests and that register is dead on the not-taken path.
mechanism: A post-reorg pass walks filled two-element SEQUENCEs; when the delay insn is a single_set of a register that appears in the branch condition, and the fall-through writes that register before reading it (or a call clobbers it), INSN_ANNULLED_BRANCH_P is set so the branch prints in its likely form (`bnezl v0,L; move v0,zero`).
default_neutrality: Wide sweep with and without the patch (flag off) is byte-identical: 231 exact, zero diffs.
rejected_default_variants: blanket rule (no branch-tested-register condition): +2 exact / -29 regressions
narrowed branch-tested-register rule without the flag: +2 / -9

control_parity.note: joint gate unchanged; the flag is per-unit
